title: kurdish-tts-stt
description: Kurdish (Sorani & Kurmanji) text-to-speech & speech-to-text — 664 AI voices. API key required.
summary: Kurdish (Sorani & Kurmanji) text-to-speech & speech-to-text — 664 AI voices. API key required.
offersHint: Kurdish (Sorani & Kurmanji) text-to-speech & speech-to-text — 664 AI voices. API key required. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://www.kurdishtts.com/api/mcp · Requires headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <ttsKey> or Bearer <ttsKey>:<sttKey> — API keys from https://www.kurdishtts.com/settings/api

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: Bearer <ttsKey> or Bearer <ttsKey>:<sttKey> — API keys from https://www.kurdishtts.com/settings/api

toolsPreview.name: list_dialects
toolsPreview.description: List the supported Kurdish dialects and their scripts. Static capability descriptor — costs nothing.

toolsPreview.name: list_voices
toolsPreview.description: List available Kurdish text-to-speech voices. Returns speaker ids (e.g. sorani_1, kurmanji_236) to use with synthesize_speech. Free metadata call — no credits consumed.

toolsPreview.name: synthesize_speech
toolsPreview.description: Convert Kurdish text (Sorani or Kurmanji) to speech audio. Requires a TTS API key; characters are billed against your plan. Max 600 characters per call over MCP — for longer texts call POST https://www.kurdishtts.com/api/tts-proxy directly (binary WAV, higher plan limits). Note: speed is caller-facing (higher = faster).

toolsPreview.name: transcribe_audio
toolsPreview.description: Transcribe Kurdish audio (Sorani or Kurmanji) to text. Requires an STT API key; usage is metered per audio minute against your plan. Max 4MB of decoded audio over MCP — for larger files call POST https://www.kurdishtts.com/api/stt-proxy directly (multipart upload).

toolsPreview.name: start_streaming_transcription
toolsPreview.description: Start a live streaming speech-to-text session. WARNING: calling this immediately consumes one streaming session from your STT plan quota — only call it when you are ready to connect. Returns a websocket_url: open it, stream PCM16 mono 16kHz audio chunks, send {"type": "finalize"} to flush and {"type": "done"} to close. Session duration is limited by plan.
